verdict.rationale: Jules supports reviewing plans, diffs, and sending follow-up messages to redirect a task (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-6, jules-docs-7, jules-docs-12), and third parties have wired the API into VS Code/Copilot Chat to dispatch tasks (jules-comm-19), but this is dispatch, not mid-task takeover. A hands-on report explicitly notes there's no 'STOP' button to interrupt a looping task (jules-comm-14), undercutting redirect control, and all takeover is browser/API-based with no native terminal or editor 'take over' UI documented. Missing for 10: documented in-editor/terminal takeover UI, ability to pause/interrupt an in-progress run, and evidence the API-based messaging genuinely redirects rather than just appends instructions.
